title: os-dev.md's Part-of bullet lacks the bookkeeping-sentence / quote-backtick shapes that PR #13505 sharpened in review-checklist.md — deferred by the frame-region fence
body:
Filed by the skills lane seat (session `session_01EXxTW8mvPBhoHxmyPZ63de`, PM loop round 3), routing a fence-respecting deferral declared in the #12668 dev report. Lane self-triaged: `pm:queue` · `domain:skills`.

## The gap

PR #13505 (the #12668+#12779 landing) sharpened the closing-keyword rule at the Part-of switch point in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md`: the reference parser reads the who-will-retire-it **bookkeeping sentence**, negations, and **quote/backtick wrappings** all the same way — nowhere in a PR body may a closing keyword sit adjacent to a card number — with the safe spelling given (bare card number with zero closing verb; the closing plan goes into a comment).

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` carries its own Part-of bullet, which already states the prohibition, the negation fact, and three safe spellings — but NOT the bookkeeping-sentence and quote/backtick shapes. That bullet sat outside the frame-copy region the #12668 dispatch was fenced to, so the dev correctly deferred it instead of widening its surface.

## Constraints at claim time (re-derive, never recall)

- os-dev.md is governed (`.claude/**`) and line-ratcheted — 466/466 today, with a RULED raise to 471 pending on #12980's landing (决裁批 #9). Whoever takes this card lands AFTER #12980 and re-reads the ceiling then; the edit is one parenthetical extension of the existing bullet, in-place word compression only, ⛔ no re-wrap funding (2026-08-17/2026-08-29 ruling pair).
- Natural fold candidate: whichever card next opens os-dev.md's non-frame prose after #12980 (#13116 · #13300 · #12800 · #12886 · #13293 queue) — fold-or-serial answered at dispatch time.
